benchmarkDenominator.total: 1979 upstream test files/artifacts inspected from a blob-filtered shallow clone: 1974 under test/ plus 5 pandoc-lua-engine test modules
benchmarkDenominator.source: .upstream-cache/pandoc at 0640c4c9859aa5a3ede082c190fcd5883c24ac83 using git ls-tree path inventory and targeted reads of pandoc.cabal, COPYRIGHT, test/test-pandoc.hs, Tests.Command, Tests.Readers.Markdown, and Tests.Writers.Native
benchmarkDenominator.warning: This is a cloned static inventory, not upstream runner parity. The full runner was not executed because ghc, cabal, and stack are not installed in this environment; upstream test-pandoc must be built as a Haskell Tasty executable and run from a full checkout. Native PHP progress maps 11 focused Markdown/WordPress writer checks, including the Tests.Readers.Markdown nested list case and three definition-list cases.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native Markdown reader and WordPress block writer for headings, paragraphs, Pandoc-style inline emphasis/strong/link/code spans, bullet lists, ordered lists, the Tests.Readers.Markdown nested indented bullet-list shape, and definition-list cases for no-blank definitions, column-zero definition markers, and lists inside definitions.

wordpressScenario: Data Liberation Markdown import path that preserves editorial emphasis, source links, code spans, ordered conversion steps, nested editorial checklists, and glossary-style definition lists as WordPress blocks or HTML.
nextTask: Map more Pandoc Tests.Readers.Markdown cases such as inline code across list markers, block quotes, fenced code blocks, or loose definition-list paragraphs.
